# XY Forever serial protocol 1.21: firmware diagnostics

Part of the [XY Forever serial protocol 1.21](../PROTOCOL.md).

### 0x48 `tfw.check_role`

Check an official firmware cut with the selected processor’s own OTP keys. Version 1, role 0=A or 1=B. Runs the full native package check locally on that
processor. A accepts cuts up to 300000 bytes and uses only its existing read-only storage session. Requires partition 0, closed write window, no open files,
jobs, package lease or boot probe. After a link error or timeout send no further commands; a ROM hang needs a manual power cycle. No keys are exported.

| Request field (18 to 248 bytes) | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `version` | u32 | format version: 1 |
| `role` | u32 | processor: 0=A, 1=B |
| `path` | cstr UTF-8, 10..240 B | absolute path under `/yaffs2/` of a `.tfw` file or a cut of one, NUL-terminated |

| Reply field, after the status (48 bytes) | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `version` | u32 | format version: 1 |
| `role` | u32 | processor: 0=A, 1=B |
| `verdict` | u32 | 0 = pass; 1 = fail. The result |
| `reason` | u32 | 0 = pass; 1 = a read failed; 2 = not a package, or its sizes differ from the file; 3 = an AES key index other than 0; 4 = the device's one-time-programmable memory gave no key; 5 = the device's public key is not on the curve; 6 = the signature does not verify; 7 = the device's key does not decrypt the package; 8 = the decrypted ZIP directory is malformed. Why |
| `public_key_sha256` | bytes[32] | SHA-256 of the device's 56-byte public key; zero when none was read |

On an error: the status only. Errors: `bad_request`, `refused`, `link`, `storage`, `not_found`, `range`, `busy`, `unsupported`. Tool timeout: 6 s. Build switch
`XYF_TFW_CHECK` (on in product builds; without it: `unsupported`). Since 1.20.
